integrity: The proof is analytic. It combines the exact Euclidean inradius/circumradius comparison for a regular polygon with the parallelogram identity and an exact residue-class alignment argument. The bundled script is only a reproducibility check of the explicit extremizers and is not used as a finite substitute for the infinite-family proof. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem applies to regular polygons with side count congruent to 4 modulo 8. It does not give the James constant for the 0 modulo 8 family and does not classify all maximizing pairs.
title: James constant of every regular \((8k+4)\)-gonal Banach plane
